mouseClicked.description: Returns whether the mouse button just got clicked this frame.

mousePressed.description: Returns whether the mouse button is held down.

parameters.button: Mouse button to check. Defaults to 'left'.

keyJustPressed.description: Returns whether a key was just pressed.

keyPressed.description: Returns whether a key is held down.

getMouseX.description: Gets the mouse X position on screen.

getMouseY.description: Gets the mouse Y position on screen.
